name: Tithely
shortDescription: A US-based church software suite for online giving, people management, communications, websites, apps, events and worship-team work.
suitableContexts: Churches that want a bundled US-market church software suite
Teams comparing a flat-rate bundle with separate specialist tools

pricing.summary: Tithely publishes US-dollar subscription prices, alongside a free giving option and a separate published UK card rate. Check the applicable UK contract and payment terms before purchase.

tiers.label: Free Giving
tiers.detail: No monthly fee; supplier publishes separate transaction rates

tiers.label: All Access
tiers.detail: Published bundle price for the supplier’s listed tools

pricing.trialDetails: The supplier advertises a 30-day free trial for paid plans.

importExport: Data-transfer help is included in the supplier’s published enterprise onboarding description

editorial.assessment: Tithely is a broad bundle with unusually clear headline prices and a UK card-rate statement. It deserves a UK-specific payment, Gift Aid, tax-receipting, data-processing and support review before a church makes it its system of record.
bestFor: Churches seeking a bundled giving, people and communications toolkit
Teams able to test their whole workflow during a 30-day trial
strengths: Free giving option and published paid-plan prices
A wide bundle spanning administration, giving, websites and apps
limitations: Most subscription prices are in US dollars
UK Gift Aid and wider UK operational fit are not confirmed in this profile

procurementVerdict.problem: Churches seeking a bundled giving, people and communications toolkit
procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Most subscription prices are in US dollars

longForm.verdict: Tithely is most useful to evaluate as a bundle, not as a list of standalone modules. The practical question is whether its giving, people, communications and public-facing tools can simplify enough work to justify moving several workflows together.

decisionLens.heading: Model the total cost of giving, not only the subscription.
decisionLens.text: The supplier publishes a £1.9% plus £0.30 UK card rate as well as US-dollar subscription figures. Before comparing options, use the church’s real donation value, transaction count and donor-fee policy, then verify settlement and Gift Aid arrangements directly with Tithely.

sections.heading: A suite that should be tested as one workflow
sections.question: Can one connected system genuinely replace the current mix?
paragraphs: Tithely describes a suite covering giving, people, volunteer coordination, check-in, messaging, sites, apps and worship planning. Its All Access plan is presented as the bundle for teams that want those tools together.

Use the trial to run a real event from sign-up through communications, volunteer scheduling and follow-up. Separately ask finance volunteers to test donor records, reconciliation exports and the exact UK Gift Aid workflow before relying on it.

userFeedback.summary: This profile does not reproduce an external review score. It is based on Tithely’s published pricing and product information, with the UK suitability questions kept separate from supplier claims.
themes: The bundle can be simpler than buying modules separately.
Transaction cost and UK finance workflow need modelling before a switch.
userFeedback.caveat: Supplier feature descriptions and review badges are not independent testing or confirmation of UK fit.

faq.question: Does Tithely offer a free plan?
faq.answer: Yes. Tithely advertises Free Giving with no monthly fee, while transaction charges still apply.

faq.question: Does Tithely offer a free trial?
faq.answer: Yes. The supplier advertises a 30-day free trial for paid plans.

faq.question: What does Tithely cost?
faq.answer: Published prices include $72/month for Church Management, $119/month for All Access, $19/month for a website and $89/month for a custom app. Confirm UK billing, VAT and payment terms with Tithely.

faq.question: Does Tithely support UK Gift Aid?
faq.answer: Not confirmed in this profile. Ask Tithely to demonstrate the required declaration, claim, export and reconciliation workflow.
